content.text:
# Local overlay: publishes the service ports on the host so the stack is usable
# from a browser, curl or a natively running backend.
#
#   docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml up --build
#   (npm run docker:local)
#
# Only for a personal machine. On a server the base file stays as it is and a
# reverse proxy joins the compose network instead — publishing Postgres or the
# ML service there would put them on a public interface.

services:
  # 5433 by default so a Postgres already running on the host's 5432 does not
  # collide. Native backend dev connects here (backend/.env: DB_PORT=5433).
  postgres:
    ports:
      - "${POSTGRES_PORT:-5433}:5432"

  ml-service:
    ports:
      - "${ML_SERVICE_PORT:-8000}:8000"

  backend:
    ports:
      - "${BACKEND_PORT:-4000}:4000"

  dashboard:
    ports:
      - "${DASHBOARD_PORT:-3000}:3000"
=== DEV ===
# Dev override: hot-reload for backend, worker and ml-service.
# Source is mounted live — no rebuild needed on code changes.
#
# Stacks on top of the local overlay, which publishes the host ports:
#   docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml \
#     -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build
#   (npm run docker:dev)
#
# Start deps only with ml-service hot-reload (backend natively):
#   docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml \
#     -f docker-compose.dev.yml up postgres qdrant ml-service -d

services:
  # tsx watch: restarts the API server on any source change under backend/.
  backend:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.dev
    image: daz-pilot-backend:dev
    command: ["npm", "run", "dev:core_backend"]
    volumes:
      - ./backend:/app
      # Keep the container's node_modules — don't let the host mount shadow them.
      - /app/node_modules
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: development

  # tsx watch: same image as `backend` dev build, watches worker.ts.
  worker:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.dev
    image: daz-pilot-backend:dev
    command: ["npm", "run", "dev:worker"]
    volumes:
      - ./backend:/app
      - /app/node_modules
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: development

  # Backups are a production concern. The profile keeps them out of the dev
  # stack; run them on demand with `--profile ops` if you want to test them.
  backup:
    profiles: ["ops"]

  # uvicorn --reload: restarts on any .py change under ml-service/.
  ml-service:
    command: ["uvicorn", "main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000", "--reload"]
    volumes:
      # Mount source live. Python deps sit in /usr/local/lib, not in /app,
      # so they are unaffected by this mount.
      - ./ml-service:/app
=== TEST ===
# Throwaway Postgres for the test suite.
#
#   docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait postgres-test
#   cd backend && npm run test:db:migrate && npm test
#
# Or via the backend scripts: `npm run test:db:up` / `npm run test:db:down`.
#
# Data lives in tmpfs, so it is gone when the container stops — there is no
# volume to clean between runs. Port 5434 keeps this clear of the dev database
# on 5433 (docker-compose.local.yml).
#
# Credentials are hardcoded to match backend/.env.test.example and are
# deliberately NOT read from root .env: a typo there must never let the test
# suite truncate the development database.

services:
  postgres-test:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    restart: "no"
    ports:
      - "5434:5432"
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: daz_test
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: daz_test
      POSTGRES_DB: daz_test
    tmpfs:
      - /var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U daz_test -d daz_test"]
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 15

observation.command: cd /workspace && cat docker-compose.local.yml && echo "=== DEV ===" && cat docker-compose.dev.yml && echo "=== TEST ===" && cat docker-compose.test.yml
